'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Artisan found with [[Gongjiang]] in [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
;(Daytime)
:'''Gongjiang:''' Have you found enough parts for our mentor?
:'''Shixi:''' Not yet. I'll probably be done by evening. 
:'''Gongjiang:''' I don't know if I'll have enough... This could be bad...

;(Nightime)
:'''Shixi:''' Finally! It took the whole day, but I've collected all the parts for our mentor.
:'''Gongjiang:''' Ugh, I'm still not done! I'm so gonna get an earful from him...

==Dialogue==
;(Day)
:'''Gongjiang:''' Have you found enough parts for our mentor?

:'''Shixi:''' Not yet. I'll probably be done by evening. 

:'''Gongjiang:''' I don't know if I'll have enough... This could be bad...

:'''Gongjiang:''' Our mentor really knows how to put us in a bind. What does he want all these parts for? Are we supposed to build a pair of Autopuppets from scratch? 

;(Night)
:'''Shixi:''' Finally! It took the whole day, but I've collected all the parts for our mentor.

:'''Gongjiang:''' Ugh, I'm still not done! I'm so gonna get an earful from him...

:'''Shixi:''' Huh? What will you do?

:'''Shixi:''' I've barely got enough. I don't think I can help you...

:'''Gongjiang:''' So that's my only end? Just get chewed out?
{{Dialogue End}}
